The FloPlast MiniFlo 50mm round downpipe socket provides a secure connection for effective rainwater drainage systems. This black uPVC component is designed for MiniFlo guttering installations, suitable for garages, sheds, summer houses, and most garden buildings. Constructed from durable uPVC, this robust fitting ensures a reliable and long-lasting solution for rainwater management. Its design facilitates a simple installation process, as no lubrication is required.
